gaps.niche: Independent restaurants in West Houston not being targeted by print vendors
gaps.demand: West Houston has 200+ independent restaurants with menus, flyers, and promotional needs. Most print shops focus on central Houston or large chains, leaving West Houston independents underserved.
gaps.opportunity: Cosmic Printing already serves West Houston and has full print + mail capabilities. Competitors lack restaurant-specific packages for this geography. A targeted outreach to West Houston restaurants could capture an untapped local market.
gaps.recommendedTarget: Independent sit-down restaurants and cafes in West Houston (77077, 77079, 77094) opened within the last 3 years, with 50+ Google reviews indicating active operations but no recent menu refresh visible online.

gaps.niche: New restaurant grand opening marketing bundles
gaps.demand: Houston sees 30-40 new independent restaurant openings per quarter. Each needs menus, signage, flyers, and direct mail for launch promotions.
gaps.opportunity: A bundled grand opening package (menu + signage + 500 flyers + EDDM mailer) would differentiate from competitors offering piecemeal services.
gaps.recommendedTarget: Restaurants opened in the last 12 months in the greater Houston area with growing review counts but basic or outdated menu presentation.

gaps.niche: Seasonal menu update campaigns for established restaurants
gaps.demand: Restaurants update menus 2-4 times per year. Each update requires reprinting menus, table tents, and promotional materials.
gaps.opportunity: Proactive outreach before known seasonal menu changes (spring, fall) positions Cosmic as the go-to vendor before competitors even bid.
gaps.recommendedTarget: Established restaurants (3+ years) with 100+ reviews showing seasonal menu changes in review mentions but no visible print vendor relationship.
